violations.text: An employee was observed washing their hands in the pre-filled wash basin of the 3 bay sink. Food employees shall clean their hands in a designated hand-washing sink and not in a food preparation, mop, or ware-washing sink. Methods on where to wash hands were reviewed during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/10/2026

Raw animal foods such as raw eggs were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods such as vegetables and fried chicken wings in the grill cooler and walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Items were replaced during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/10/2026

Peppers and onions and grilled shrimp were observed held at 110-112 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were reheated during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/10/2026
Cooked carnitas was observed held past 7 days. Food was voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/10/2026
Partition required between 3 bay sink and food prep sink. New Violation. Correct By: 11/24/2026
3 bay sink leaking when draining from discharge pipe. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 11/24/2026

The sink used for food preparation is lacking an air gap and currently has an air break. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. PIC informed. https://datahealth.ri.gov/publications/factsheets/air-gaps-backflow-prevention.pdf New Violation. Correct By: 11/24/2026

The food prep sink does not have an airgap. The food prep sink has an airbreak. https://datahealth.ri.gov/publications/factsheets/air-gaps-backflow-prevention.pdf New Violation. Correct By: 10/13/2026
The doors to all toilet rooms (3) are not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 10/13/2026

The floor and wall junctures in the walk-in cooler and walk-in freezer and adjoining panels (walls and floors) do not have coving and/or is not sealed for effective cleanability. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 10/13/2026

The floor tiles where the floor drains meet are not finished (exposing tile and subfloor materials). Theses areas must be durable, easily cleanable and nonabsorbent due to subjectivity to moisture from food preparation and sanitiation . New Violation. Correct By: 10/13/2026
